title: Core signed-shift model laws
statement:
theorem podReindexingTensorSignedShifts_core
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (D : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (hD : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g D)
    (T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E g D)
    (hT : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l E g D T) :
    ∃ SY : PodTensorSignedShift l E Y, ∃ SX : PodTensorSignedShift l E X,
      NatTrans.CommShift D.reduction.hom ℤ ∧ NatTrans.CommShift D.limit.hom ℤ ∧
      PodLimitSignedShift l E Y D.sourceRoos D.shiftSource ∧
      PodLimitSignedShift l E X D.targetRoos D.shiftTarget ∧
      SY.Generators l E ∧ SX.Generators l E ∧
      SY.Model l E D.shiftSource ∧ SX.Model l E D.shiftTarget

proof.text: First construct the two signed tensor shift models and their Generators and Model laws. Then apply their compatibility theorem to obtain the reduction and limit CommShift structures and the two PodLimitSignedShift laws. Assemble these ten conjuncts in the order of the target statement.

proof_origin.place: Assembly of the explicitly split model and compatibility statements.
